goal: Rebuild Blockworks as a haunted castle in an abandoned tropical island theme park, with Crash 2-inspired stylized shapes and rich hand-painted low-poly assets.

constraints.farSceneryAuthority: One level-wide skybox and shared scenery mattes; ignore per-storyboard distant scenery discrepancies
constraints.matchPriority: Playable foreground and surrounding local scenery
constraints.storyboardGate: User advanced production from accepted reviewed reference set
constraints.foregroundConstruction: User requires actual textured Meshy components assembled into architecture; no manually tiled shader surfaces.

evidence.baselineJourney: Existing input pilot dies at the newly added entry moa, station 47.18, frame 203. This predates the art changes; capture viewpoints are inspection placements, not proof of a successful gameplay run.
evidence.baselineBuild: TypeScript noEmit + Vite production build passed; 495 modules; no runtime changes yet
evidence.supportReview: All ordinary capture poses checked against collision; one ramp pose at 272 corrected; special aerial/rail/mover inspections are explicitly marked
evidence.referenceCoverage: 89 reviewed references across all 8 districts; 11 late crown duplicate views remain optional. No claim of 100 generated frames.
evidence.automation: Heartbeat no longer exists in app. Attempt to pause after first verified deployment returned not found; no active heartbeat file exists.
evidence.meshyApproval: Initial automated review rejection resolved after user explicitly reiterated Meshy-component construction. First four provider submissions accepted; task IDs recorded.
evidence.meshProvenance: All 15 originals, textures and UVs retained; provider task IDs, model hashes, dimensions and triangle counts saved in asset-manifest.json and public provenance files.
evidence.fullJourney: Updated pilot carves around opening moa via real inputs. Continuous spawn-to-finish passed: 20157 frames, 335.95 simulation seconds, six checkpoints, no deaths or resets, max step 0.7956m. Recorded before final module assembly; repeat on final state.
evidence.latestStructure: Native support, gaps, checkpoints and editor normalization pass with Meshy path modules. Node fixture emits existing unrelated bonus GLB fetch warning; real-browser captures have zero console errors.
evidence.fullRenderAqueduct: PASS current-main browser: 4839 input-only physics frames, both high-air centre crates, peak15.85m, native-camera apex framing, rail transfer and checkpoint, zero console errors.

evidence.checkLevels: PASS current-main package.json check:levels commands via bundled Node.
evidence.build: PASS current-main tsc and Vite production build; offline bundle 1031 files/506.8MiB.
evidence.browserSmoke: PASS full-render real input cases: supported spawn/forward motion; committed pit fall, observed death and supported respawn; checkpoint; inactive/activated Meshy switch surfaces; actual finish gate. Zero console errors.
evidence.performance: Spawn sample in full-render Chrome: median 16.5ms, p95 21.4ms. Not a whole-level performance claim.
evidence.visualReview: 100 rendered views inspected in seven contact sheets. Found source-ground grey underlay and invalid pose at 2072; underlay hidden without collision changes, pose recaptured on supported crown roof. Final full capture must be refreshed after current-main integration.
evidence.upstream: origin/main force-updated from original 27884c4 to 19300ea during work; preserve all current main changes. Blockworks now has raised entry/machinery rails and restored edge grinding upstream.
evidence.taskRebase: Completed onto origin/main 19300ea; kept upstream Blockworks raised rails, default edge grinding, world surface toolkit, current sky/mist ownership, current pilot and every unrelated main change.
evidence.nativeGeometry: 1432 native gameplay components match current-main 19300ea contract; 15 packed GLB hashes, embedded textures and UVs verified. Generated render meshes explicitly opt out of WorldSurfaceBinding collision.
evidence.focusedChecks: PASS Blockworks structure, platform edge grinding, skate wedge traversal, native physics signature and asset budget/hash checks.
evidence.publicLevelPack: Blockworks is already a source-owned built-in (codex-lab), not an entry in public/levels.json. The built-in registry publishes this source directly; no duplicate editor-pack entry was added.
evidence.foregroundAttachmentFix: Lantern bases and foliage now intersect the supporting masonry. Explicit facade dimensions also work below one metre; thin lift guides use one inward-facing skin inside the native footprint. Native physics hash unchanged; 100 refreshed views, TypeScript, shared renderer, structure, check:levels and build passed.

next: Higher-fidelity pass is published and verified. Use the saved comparisons and remaining foreground differences for any further continuation. Keep the coherent sky and world-placed far mattes; never claim literal 1:1 parity from the current evidence.
